name: grounded-support
task: Answer one customer question from the shop's support documents, cite the passage used, and reject blank text.

cases.input: How long do I have to ask for a refund?
cases.why: The refund policy changed from 14 to 30 days.

cases.input: How long does standard delivery take?
cases.why: A direct question about one document.

cases.input: Can I change the delivery address after I order?
cases.why: The answer is yes, until the order ships.

cases.input: What should I do with a parcel I no longer want?
cases.why: The question shares few words with the returns document.
Blank text must be rejected, not sent to the model.

cases.input: Does the warranty cover a laptop I dropped?
cases.why: Dropping is accidental damage, which the warranty excludes.

cases.input: Someone changed my password. What should I do?
cases.why: The customer must reset the password and contact support.

cases.input: Where can I see when my order will arrive?
cases.why: The tracking link answers the question.

cases.input: How much faster is express delivery?
cases.why: Express takes one working day against three to five.
